attempts.raw: {"risk": 4, "reason": "Reverting the SQLite database filename from OrchardCore.db back to yessql.db (and removing the configurable DatabaseName option) will make existing tenants created since the original change unable to find their data unless they were already relying on the old default, effectively causing silent data-access breakage for a subset of installations."}

reason: Reverting the SQLite database filename from OrchardCore.db back to yessql.db (and removing the configurable DatabaseName option) will make existing tenants created since the original change unable to find their data unless they were already relying on the old default, effectively causing silent data-access breakage for a subset of installations.
